slides.title: Do you *test* the people who love you?
slides.sub: It's one of the relationship patterns Bill works on at Pathways.

slides.title: It has company
slides.body: Testing the people who love you often travels with the come-here, go-away cycle and anger aimed at the wrong target.

slides.title: Where the work starts
slides.body: "Be true to yourself and your feelings." Bill Burrows
